thought.text: Lass mich Caches löschen und Node neu starten:

reasoning_content: Server starts but same error! The error comes from BEFORE the WorldTick code - it's happening while loading/importing. Let me verify this is not a caching issue with tsx.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Clear node cache
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("rm -rf /opt/areloria/node_modules/.cache 2>&1 | tail -1")

# Stop and start PM2 completely
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all 2>&1 | tail -2")

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/server && pm2 start src/index.ts --name areloria 2>&1 | tail -3")

time.sleep(15)

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' http://localhost:3000")
print("HTTP:", stdout.read().decode())

stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ss -tlnp | grep 3000")
print("Port:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
